description: List the company's BAS chart of accounts: account numbers with names. Use it to find the account number the ledger and balance tools take; bokio_get_account reads a single account.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

name: bokio_chart_of_accounts
